description: References for the GENARCH Annual Report 2026, in two sets, because they carry different guarantees. The references set is journal literature: every entry has a DOI, and a verification block records how that DOI was checked rather than asserting that it was. The sources set is agency documents, regulations and dataset releases, which have no DOIs; every entry names a publisher, a title, the edition or version date, a stable URL and the date it was retrieved, so a reader can reach the same bytes.
policy: A literature entry without a DOI is not added: the work is cited as a source entry or not cited. A source entry missing any of its five required fields fails tests/test_report_source.py. A DOI taken from the Crossref-verified bibliography carries method crossref and that check's date; a DOI taken from a published atlas record carries method atlas-record and the record path, and is not claimed as independently verified here.
